name: Botifarra
description: Botifarra is the most iconic card game of Catalonia, Spain. A point-trick partnership game related to Manille, it is played with a 48-card Spanish deck where the 9 (the 'Manille') is the highest trump. It is unique for its strict 'Obligatory Trumping' rules and its bidding system, where the dealer can choose the trump or delegate the choice to their partner ('Delegar'). The game is a staple of Catalan culture, combining rigorous strategic discipline with intense social rivalry.

content.text: Botifarra is the most iconic card game of Catalonia, Spain. A point-trick partnership game related to Manille, it is played with a 48-card Spanish deck where the 9 (the 'Manille') is the highest trump. It is unique for its strict 'Obligatory Trumping' rules and its bidding system, where the dealer can choose the trump or delegate the choice to their partner ('Delegar'). The game is a staple of Catalan culture, combining rigorous strategic discipline with intense social rivalry.

Originating in rural Catalonia in the 19th century, Botifarra evolved from the older game of Manille. Its name literally refers to a type of Catalan sausage, though in the game it denotes the 'Botifarra' (No Trump) contract.
48 cards (1-12 in Coins, Cups, Swords, Batons). Ranking: 9 (Manille, 5 pts), Ace (4 pts), King (3 pts), Knight (2 pts), Jack (1 pt), then 12, 11, 10, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 (0 pts).
Deal all 48 cards clockwise (12 to each player).

items.text: Strict Trumping: Standard tournament rules: you must always trump if void, even if your partner is currently winning the trick.
